content.short: Port Finance is a Solana DeFi money market protocol offering variable interest rates, cross-collateral lending, and flash loans.
content.description: Port Finance is a non-custodial money market protocol built on Solana that lets users lend and borrow digital assets without relinquishing custody. It offers variable interest rates that adapt to supply and demand, cross-collateral lending, and flash loans. Cross-collateral lending supports up to nine different crypto assets for a single loan. The PORT governance token empowers the community to vote on collateral ratios, new asset support, liquidation thresholds, and other protocol parameters.
